- Modules, data ownership and public interfaces affected:

## Verification

- Candidate commit:
- Commands and actual results:
- [ ] File limit and Python design checks pass without bypasses.
- [ ] Normal and boundary paths tested.
- [ ] Forbidden and failure paths tested, or non-applicability explained.
- [ ] Concurrency / retries / historical versions tested where relevant.
- [ ] New gate violations are shown to fail, including through hooks.
- Unsupported languages / static-analysis blind spots / unverified risks:

## Review

- Independent reviewer and conclusion (write **not independently reviewed** if absent):
- [ ] Responsibilities, readable control flow and module boundaries reviewed.
- [ ] Gate code, test deletions and threshold changes explicitly reviewed.
- High-risk changes and remaining concerns:

Detailed project checklist: [change-review.md](https://github.com/hotalexnet/engineering-guardrails/blob/main/assets/project-kit/docs/change-review.md).

Checkboxes are evidence prompts, not approval. Passing CI does not imply an independent review or protected branches.
